answer: Require each agent to keep proving it stores its own unique 50 GB block of random data, a proof of space-time. Every epoch the network sends a random challenge, like light through a prism hitting one slice, and the agent must answer from that exact slice within seconds. An honest agent tends one small garden of disk. A Sybil operator running 1,000 fakes must buy and keep online 50 TB, a steady river of hardware and power costs that grows with every extra identity.
